- Exact target: the /pricing page on the production marketing site (replace the current live content).
- Source/version to publish: the approved pricing copy you signed off (please confirm whether that is the version in the CMS labeled “approved,” the draft currently on staging, or a specific file/link — paste the link or name).
- Scope: one occurrence (apply immediately to production now).
- Reversible: Yes — I will revert the page to the previous live version if you ask after it’s live.

Please reply with a single explicit confirmation like:
“Confirm — publish [CMS: Approved v3] to /pricing now”
or, if you want a different source, give the link/name and then “Confirm — publish that to /pricing now.”
